jobs.title: Senior Product Owner m/w/d
Product Manager Foundations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Unzer is a leading European fintech company with a mission to simplify international payments for e-commerce and retail businesses. Our brand was formed from 13 companies that now contribute to building a unique product covering the entire payment flow.  
 
At Unzer, we are driven by the belief that customers should enjoy a seamless shopping experience, no matter where they choose to shop. We are a team of over 750 experts from 70 different nationalities, dedicated to creating a state-of-the-art unified commerce platform. Our goal is to enable businesses to delight their customers with a seamless payment experience.  
 
Whether you're a tech enthusiast, payment expert, or dedicated support professional, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about making a difference.  
  
Our offices: We are based across Austria, Denmark, Germany, and Luxembourg with a HQ in Berlin.

ABOUT THE TEAM

As a Product Manager at Unzer, your mission is to deliver product value. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization, analyze customer feedback, and serve as the subject-matter expert in your domain. Your focus will be to translate insights into actionable specifications and guide product development within your team to ensure the on-time delivery of real, measurable impact that supports company goals. 
 
You will lead platform-wide initiatives in our Foundations group. The team owns the core components of UnzerOne – a modern platform enabling seamless unified commerce solutions for our merchants and fully automated end-to-end (onboarding to settlement) flows to empower our internal stakeholders. 

What your work will look like:

  • Merchant journey: Establish a deep understanding of our merchants’ journey throughout the Unzer platform, from onboarding to settlement, opportunities and pain-points.

  • Manage and Deliver the Product Roadmap: Maintain and own the product roadmap for your area of responsibility, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and on-time delivery of product enhancements and features. 

  • Own Product Initiatives: Plan and execute product initiatives end to end, demonstrating full product ownership and autonomy. 
  • KPI Definition & Performance Tracking: Define and track KPIs to measure product success and drive continuous improvement. 
  • Solve Complex Challenges: Proactively resolve complex challenges across varied product contexts by in-depth analysis from technical and business perspectives and focusing teams on delivering solutions. 

    • Manage Communication and Collaboration: Enable collaboration within your team and communication with stakeholders outside your team, ensuring a shared understanding and effective product delivery. 


What you need to be successful in this role:
  • 3+ years’ product management experience in Tech, ideally in Payments on billing and settlement solutions - a plus if gained within a financially regulated company. 
  • You are skilled at planning, driving, and monitoring product development to meet objectives in high quality and on time. 
  • Your decisions are informed by data, and you are experienced with investigating and resolving a broad range of complex issues in the technology space. 
  • You facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing within cross-functional teams, engaging stakeholders and ensuring user or customer needs are met. 
  • You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, comfortably explaining complex concepts, gaining insights and supporting decision-making. 
  • You bring creativity and an improvement mindset, proposing new solutions, encouraging team enhancements, and implementing changes. 
  • You demonstrate leadership and adaptability by embracing change and actively promoting new technologies and the use of AI in daily work. 

What’s next?
  • Does it sound exciting? -  Apply with your CV in English. Please don’t shy away if you don’t meet all the requirements! We’re looking forward to meeting you.  
  • The interview process includes: a 30min intro call with a TA Partner, a 60-min Hiring Manager interview, a 60-min skills assessment call with the team and an executive interview, 30 min. Please note the process might alter depending on our team’s availability. 
    • WHAT'S IN THERE FOR YOU :
     
    🏡 Work from home up to 60% of the time. We want you to keep your work-life balance. 
    🚲 Mobility support, whether you choose Swapfiets, Jobrad, or a Deutschlandticket - we've got you covered. 
    🫴 Explore counseling assistance, be it for professional or personal matters, through our associated platform. 
    💰 Pension scheme, we want to give back and help you secure your future. 
    🏖️ 15 days a year to work from your desired destination within the EU.
    🕟 Flexible working hours – helping you balance work and life
    📗 Learning budget of 1000 euros per year – you can develop your passions with us. 
    🎉 Enjoy some fun moments with your coworkers – we throw a company party once a year and host several team events! 
     
    We are committed to protecting your personal data. Please find our applicant privacy information here.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Platform
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • AI enablement 🤖 – We believe in working smarter—everyone gets an unlimited AI budget to explore and use the best tools to boost productivity and creativity.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Decision Engine
jobs.description:
About the Role

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager.

We are building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions across lending, anti money laundering, fraud prevention, and many other use cases.

At the core of many of these decisions lies our Decision Engine. As a Senior Product Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining and evolving this critical part of the Taktile platform. You will work closely with engineering to balance the demands of a rapidly growing customer base and collaborate with design to define what data-driven workflow authoring should look like in an agent-first world.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and long-term success for a critical pillar of the Taktile platform

  • Build a deep understanding of customer needs, competitive landscape and opportunities for differentiation, collaborating with customer-facing teams

  • Translate customer insights into well thought out product requirements

  • Define a compelling long-term vision for your product area and prioritize the product roadmap necessary to reach this vision

  • Balance innovation with a high reliability bar

  • Track product performance through metrics and user feedback, identifying opportunities for iteration

Who You Are

  • 5+ yrs work experience in Product Management, ideally with some financial services and B2B SaaS experience

  • Familiarity with data-oriented and highly technical products, and an appetite to deepen your technical understanding. Experience in building critical, high-availability systems is a strong plus

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to build trust and influence decisions across functions

  • Track record of delivering lasting customer impact through shipping well-thought out product improvements

  • Aptitude and appetite for using data to inform your decision-making. Basic SQL proficiency strongly preferred

  • Hands-on, curious, and willing to challenge yourself and grow your scope of responsibilities over time

Our Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you, and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy that allows you to make an impact and meaningfully impact a critical area of our product

  • Experience a flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe including the founders of Looker, Datadog, GitHub, and UiPath

  • Enjoy annual offsites where the entire company co-locates to collaborate in person

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package as well as access to a self-development budget

  • Work at our prime office locations in Berlin or London for three days per week or more

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

About Us

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, Berlin, London, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $184M from Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com

 

About Your Employment. Taktile operates through regional entities worldwide. Depending on the location of this role, your employment or engagement will be with Taktile LLC (US), Taktile GmbH (Germany), Taktile Ltd (UK), or Taktile SRL (Romania). The applicable entity will be confirmed during the offer process.

Your Privacy. Taktile (“we” or “us”) is the controller of the personal data you provide during this

application process. We collect and process your name, contact details, resume/CV, work history, education, and any other information you submit or that we obtain from publicly available sources or references.

How we use your data: We process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy, communicate with you about the recruitment process, comply with legal obligations (such as right-to-work verification), and, with your consent, to consider you for future opportunities.

Legal basis (EU/UK applicants): We rely on (i) pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR/UK GDPR Art.6(1)(b)), (ii) legal obligations (Art. 6(1)(c)), and (iii) our legitimate interest in evaluating candidates (Art.6(1)(f)).

Retention: If your application is unsuccessful, we retain your data for 12 months after the recruitment process concludes, unless you consent to longer retention. Successful candidates’ data becomes part of their employment records.

Your rights: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, to data portability, and to withdraw consent.

Automated decision-making: We use automated tools to assist in screening applications. No hiring decision is made solely by automated means without human review.

International transfers: Your data may be transferred to and processed in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, or Romania. Where required, transfers are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses or other approved mechanisms.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Taktile’s Applicant Privacy Policy. To exercise your rights or ask questions, contact -----

jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketing (parental cover)
jobs.description:
KAYAK/momondo, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Product Manager, Marketing to own and optimize our SEM Marketing Landing Pages—the critical first touchpoint for millions of travelers finding their perfect trip through search marketing. In this fixed-term role (12-18 months), you will bridge marketing performance with user experience, driving measurable improvements through rigorous experimentation and data-driven optimization.

As Product Manager for SEM Landing Pages, you will lead a cross-functional team including Engineering, Design, SEO, and Performance Marketing to develop, test, and iterate on landing page experiences that convert. You will own the hypothesis-to-insight pipeline: identifying opportunities, designing A/B tests, analyzing results, and translating findings into actionable product improvements. This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, as you'll need to balance long-term vision with the discipline of rapid testing and learning.

This position requires you to commute to our Berlin office 3 times a week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the SEM landing page product roadmap, prioritizing features and experiments based on conversion impact, user experience, and alignment with marketing objectives

  • Design and execute a continuous testing program, developing hypotheses, running A/B and multivariate tests, and driving statistically rigorous analysis to inform product decisions

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering (who build the pages), SEO (for organic/paid alignment), Design (for user experience), and Performance Marketing (for campaign strategy and goals)

  • Manage the full product lifecycle for landing page features, from initial concept and user research through technical requirements, sprint planning, launch, and post-launch measurement

  • Analyze performance data using SQL, analytics tools, and testing platforms to identify friction points, growth opportunities, and winning variations

  • Champion the user perspective while balancing business goals, ensuring landing pages deliver value to travelers while meeting marketing efficiency targets

  • Communicate insights and progress to product leadership and marketing stakeholders, translating test results into strategic recommendations

  • Drive continuous improvement through iterative testing, performance monitoring, and a relentless focus on conversion rate optimization

Please apply if you have:

  • Have 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in product management, preferably in a B2C tech, e-commerce, or travel company.

  • Possess a proven ability to independently manage and ship product features in an agile environment.

  • Have demonstrated experience owning product features from concept to launch, including managing a backlog and working with engineering squads.

  • Maintain strong analytical skills, with experience in A/B testing and data analysis to drive strategic decisions.

  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build consensus across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Bring a strong sense of user empathy and a passion for building products that solve real-world traveler problems.

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or have equivalent hands-on professional experience.

  • Thrive in a high-ownership environment where you can take initiative and move projects forward with minimal supervision.

Benefits and Perks

  • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager: Fulfillment Center
jobs.description:
Rohlík Group is one of Europe’s fastest-growing online grocery platforms, changing how people eat and live. Founded in 2014 in the Czech Republic, we’ve grown into a trusted brand with more than one million customers across Czechia, Hungary, Austria, Germany, and Romania.

Join us in building the future of e-grocery operations at a European scale. We are on a mission to create a winning operations model, leveraging cutting-edge automation, autonomous last-mile delivery, and AI-driven management systems.

You will work alongside top experts in Operations Research, AI, Warehousing and Logistics, tackling some of the most complex challenges in same-day delivery for 20,000+ products.

Our unique R&D teams specialize in simulation, optimization, and autonomous decision-making, designing the next generation of warehouse and last-mile automation. Whether it's enhancing robotic picking, optimizing AutoStore systems, or building the autonomous brain behind our entire fulfillment model, your work will directly shape the future of logistics innovation. If you're driven by disruptive innovations, process optimisation, data, and real-world impact, this is your opportunity to make a difference in one of Europe’s most advanced e-commerce operations.

Role Overview

The Principal Product Manager (PPM) is responsible for driving the strategy and execution of the assigned business stream within operations, leading multiple innovation projects, and ensuring the delivery of impactful improvements. This role oversees a team of Product Owners and Process Designers, aligning business objectives with other streams, technology, and operations teams to maximize efficiency and scalability.

The PPM collaborates closely with Engineering, Operations, and Data teams to define roadmaps, manage dependencies, and implement high-value initiatives. The role requires a balance of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and strong leadership to drive measurable improvements in key operational KPIs.


What we expect from you / the position to perform

1. Business Stream Leadership & Strategy

  • Owns the product strategy and success for a given business stream

  • Defines long-term vision and ensures alignment with company-wide goals

  • Identifies key operational constraints, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities

  • Ensures business impact by setting measurable Input & Output KPIs for the stream

2. Leadership & Team Management

  • Leads a team of 2 Senior Product Owners, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and priorities

  • Provides mentorship, feedback, and career development opportunities to team members

  • Ensures effective cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Operations, and Data teams

  • Ensures the team's skills are aligned with the business needs and ambitions

3. Execution & Delivery

  • Oversees the execution of multiple innovation projects within the business stream.

  • Facilitates decision-making, prioritization, and trade-off analysis to maximize value delivery

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Operational Excellence to ensure on-time and high-quality implementation of product features and process improvements

  • Aligns multiple squads and stakeholders to remove bottlenecks and drive results

4. Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Uses data analytics to identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and areas for automation

  • Defines and monitors input and output metrics to measure business impact

  • Leads A/B tests, pilot programs, and post-implementation audits to validate effectiveness

5. Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Ensures effective communication across departments and leadership to align expectations

  • Owns the management of the change process, including documentation, training, and rollout strategies

  • Drives collaboration between product, engineering, and operations to balance technical feasibility and operational needs

What do we look for

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, operations, or logistics

  • Proven ability to lead multiple parallel projects and cross-functional teams

  • Experience managing Product Owners or project teams in a high-growth environment.

  • Strong understanding of warehouse automation, last-mile logistics, or supply chain operations.

  • Deep expertise in process design, Lean, Six Sigma, and operational efficiency methodologies.

  • Ability to analyze large datasets to drive decision-making and performance improvements.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills – ability to work with Engineering, Operations, and Leadership.

  • Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and working in an iterative environment.

  • Advanced English (C1+), German or Czech is an advantage.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30-50% to operational sites.

Nice to have

  • experience with automation technology (AMRs, Autostore, Robotic Picking, shuttles etc.)


What’s in it for you

jobs.title: Energy Product Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits professionelle Erfahrung im Bereich Energy Management Systeme (EMS/HEMS) und/oder mit IoT- und Datenplattformen

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von Smart Metering, CLS/§14a EnWG, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung oder Flexibilitätsvermarktung

  • Du kannst technische Komplexität strukturieren und in klare Produktanforderungen, Roadmaps, Spezifikationen und Entscheidungsvorlagen übersetzen.

  • Du bist stark in Research, Strukturierung und Entscheidungsfindung und kannst Make/Partner/Buy-Optionen fundiert aufbereiten.

  • Du hast keine Berührungsängste mit regulatorischen Themen und kannst dich eigenständig in energiewirtschaftliche Fragestellungen einarbeiten.

  • Du nutzt Daten und Metriken, um Hypothesen zu validieren, Prioritäten zu begründen und Produktentscheidungen messbar zu machen

  • Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Energiewelt und Start-ups oder Immobilien mit

  • Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

 

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Als Product Manager Energy bist du verantwortlich dafür, aufbauend auf unserer Smart-Meter- und CLS-Infrastruktur ein “first-of-its-kind” Energiemanagement- und Steuerungsprodukt zu entwickeln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem COO sowie externen Partnern wie aEMT-, CLS-, GWA-, Hardware- und Software-Anbietern zusammen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, technische, regulatorische und kommerzielle Anforderungen zu verstehen und daraus eine klare Produkt-Roadmap, belastbare Spezifikationen und funktionierende Piloten abzuleiten.

1. Produktentwicklung für Energy Intelligence (insb. EMS)

  • Du übernimmst die produktseitige Verantwortung für unseren neuen Energy-Intelligence-Layer auf Basis von Smart Metern, CLS-Steuerboxen und steuerbaren Assets

  • Du analysierst, welche Daten wir in welcher Granularität benötigen, z. B. Erzeugung, Verbrauch, Netzbezug, Einspeisung, Batteriestatus, Wärmepumpenlast, Wallbox-Verbrauch und Anlagenzustände

  • Du entwickelst erste Steuerlogiken und Produktkonzepte für Use Cases wie Eigenverbrauchsoptimierung, §14a-Steuerbarkeit, dynamische Stromtarife, Direktvermarktung und perspektivisch Flexibilität/VPP

2. Piloten, Partner und technische Konzeption

  • Du hilfst uns, die Frage zu beantworten: Was bauen wir selbst, was machen wir mit Partnern, was kaufen oder integrieren wir?

  • Du baust ein klares Verständnis dafür auf, welche Hardware-, Daten- und Steuerungsarchitektur wir für verschiedene Gebäudetypen und Asset-Kombinationen benötigen

  • Du übersetzt energiewirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen in konkrete Produktanforderungen, User Stories, Datenmodelle, Schnittstellenanforderungen und Akzeptanzkriterien

3. Markt, Regulierung und strategische Produktentwicklung

  • Du beobachtest relevante regulatorische Entwicklungen, insbesondere rund um CLS, §14a EnWG, Smart Metering, dynamische Tarife, Direktvermarktung, Energy Sharing und Flexibilität

  • Du priorisierst Use Cases nach Kundennutzen, technischer Umsetzbarkeit, regulatorischer Relevanz und kommerziellem Potenzial

  • Du managst gemeinsam mit Cedric (COO) und Martin (Head of Engineering) die Roadmap für unsere Energy-Produkte

 

Benefits

Verantwortung: zentrale Rolle in unserem Kernteam

Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen

Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet

Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket

Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für Unternehmertum und Start-ups. Bei uns entstehen keine endlosen Slide-Decks oder rein theoretische Modelle – wir bauen ein Unternehmen und machen tagtäglich einen großen Schritt nach vorne. Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

 

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Bei VREY sind wir davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt uns als Unternehmen und Gesellschaft stärkt. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wenn du von unserer Mission begeistert bist und glaubst, einen Beitrag leisten zu können, möchten wir von dir hören!

Der beste Weg ist eine warme Intro: Kennst du jemand, der auf diese Rolle passt? Empfiehl die Person und erhalte 3.000€ bei erfolgreicher Einstellung.
Voraussetzung: Die Person ist uns noch nicht bei uns im Prozess und wird offiziell vorgeschlagen. Auszahlung nach bestandener Probezeit. Bei mehrfacher Nennung zählt die erste eingegangene Empfehlung.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead
jobs.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Senior Project Manager - PMO Lead

As Neara scales globally, we are investing in the operational rigor required to maintain excellence across an increasingly complex portfolio of customer engagements. To that end, we are hiring a Senior Project Manager for our European business: a position dedicated to software delivery and project management excellence, internal and customer training, and maintaining the connective tissue between our customer value, solutions and engineering teams.

PMO is a new team that you will shape and operationalize, owning several critical functions which have to date, either operated in a more disaggregated manner or not existed at all. This is an exciting opportunity to build an important part of the Neara engine, with scope to influence global operations strategy as a senior member of the team in one of our fastest growing markets.

What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end delivery for a portfolio of complex, high-value enterprise software implementations, from kickoff through go-live and handover.

  • Apply and reinforce project management best practices and standards across your projects, setting the bar for how implementations should run.

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date project tracking and reporting - status, risks, milestones, and value delivery - and roll it up into team-level rituals and leadership dashboards.

  • Identify risks and blockers early, and drive them to resolution by coordinating across Customer Success, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with the VP of CS and the wider CS team to refine PMO tooling, templates, and reporting infrastructure as the function matures.

  • Support contract and scope reviews with Product and Engineering to ensure projects are resourced and configured for success from the start.

  • Design and maintain Customer Success team onboarding and continuous learning systems.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of project management experience, ideally as a Project Manager, Delivery Manager, Implementation Manager, or Professional Services Manager, within a formal PMO, high-growth software, consulting, or enterprise technology environment.

  • Direct experience running enterprise software deployments or large-scale transformation programs, with a clear understanding of what makes complex implementations succeed or fail.

  • Track record of applying, and improving, project management standards and processes rather than just operating within an existing framework.

  • Comfortable working at multiple altitudes: following a defined methodology one day, unblocking execution on the ground the next.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex project status, risks, and trade-offs into clear narratives for senior leadership and customers.

  • Comfortable with data and tooling - able to build and maintain (automated) reporting, dashboards, and tracking systems, and confident working with project management tools (e.g., Fibery, Jira, Asana, or similar).

  • Experience within infrastructure, and specifically the energy sector, is a plus but not essential.

  • Fluent in English (must) and other European languages (preferred).

What We Offer:

  • This is a rare opportunity to help stand up a brand-new PMO function for Neara. You will run some of our most important customer implementations while directly shaping the standards and tooling that scale our customer success operations in our largest market.

Platform Engineering (platformengineering.org) is home to the world's largest community of platform engineers. Through PlatformCon, one of the world's largest conferences dedicated to platform engineering, we bring together more than 50,000 engineers, technology leaders, and decision-makers every year to share ideas, showcase innovation, and shape the future of internal developer platforms.

Alongside our events, we publish research, run a university, and produce content that reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers worldwide. In practice, we're a media house for a technical audience.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Video Producer to own video across the organization, end to end.

This is a build-it role. We don't have a video function yet. What we have is freelancers, ambition, and an audience that already trusts us. You'll come in and create the system: how we shoot, how we edit, how we publish, and how our YouTube channel grows.

You'll own the craft and the pipeline. That means editing the bulk of our output yourself, but also deciding what camera our founders point at themselves, how their rooms are lit, how their audio is captured, and what "good" looks like before anyone hits record. It means owning our YouTube channel as a channel, with packaging, Shorts, retention, and growth all in scope, rather than treating it as a place to upload finished files.

We're a distributed team, so most of what we make is produced remotely. A few times a year we come together at offsites across Europe and beyond, and you'll turn those into concentrated production windows where we capture a quarter's worth of higher-production content in a few days.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end video production: concept, shoot setup, edit, post, publish, and performance review.

  • Define and maintain our remote production standards for cameras, lenses, microphones, lighting, and backgrounds, and set up the team so a home office consistently produces broadcast-credible video.

  • Coach on-camera talent, including our founders, on framing, audio, pacing, and delivery, and hold the standard once it's set.

  • Edit the majority of our weekly output across long-form, interview, explainer, event, and short-form content.

  • Own our YouTube channel: packaging, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, chapters, SEO, and publishing cadence.

  • Build and run our Shorts strategy as a deliberate format, not as offcuts from long-form.

  • Analyze channel performance across retention, CTR, watch time, and subscriber growth, and use it to decide what we make next.

  • Plan and run quarterly production sprints at our in-person offsites, including shot lists, scheduling, and directing local crew where needed.

  • Capture and repurpose content from PlatformCon and our other events.

  • Build the systems behind all of this: intake and brief formats, turnaround expectations, asset libraries, templates, and brand kit.

  • Manage a bench of external animators, editors, and specialists for advanced motion work and high-volume weeks.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience, including substantial hands-on responsibility for video production and post-production

  • Demonstrable ownership of video end to end. You've been the person responsible for the output, not one step in someone else's pipeline.

  • Expert-level editing skills in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut, with strong color and audio finishing.

  • Real command of production fundamentals: camera selection and settings, lens choice, lighting design, and audio capture, including how to get all of it right in a spare bedroom rather than a studio.

  • Genuine YouTube expertise. You understand how the algorithm actually rewards content, you've packaged videos that outperformed their baseline, and you can explain why a video underperformed beyond "the thumbnail was weak."

  • A track record with short-form: you know what makes a Short retain, and you've made them work as a format in their own right.

  • Native-level English proficiency.

  • Experience producing video for technical or developer audiences, and comfort with the subject matter.

  • Motion graphics and animation skills (After Effects or similar).

  • Experience growing a YouTube channel with numbers you can point to.

  • Podcast production and audio post experience.

  • Experience running multi-day batch shoots or studio days.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted editing and production tooling, and a practical view on where it helps.

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up, and with remote, globally distributed teams.

Why join us?

You'd be the first video hire at an organization that already has the audience, the access, and the credibility, and no one shaping how any of it looks on screen. There's no existing system to inherit or work around. You define it.

You'll have direct access to the people building and running the world's most interesting internal developer platforms, and the freedom to decide how their stories get told. If you want a role where your judgment sets the standard rather than executes someone else's, this is that role.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You are DevOps Engineer #3. You join a Lead DevOps who has laid the groundwork - now you help scale it. You'll shape the infrastructure, automation, and reliability standards that let the entire engineering team ship faster and more safely.

You own big projects and drive them autonomously. You'll build and operate the platform that everything runs on - AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability, incident response, end to end. You work across engineering, security, and product to turn infrastructure into a competitive advantage. You design for failure, automate everything you can, and raise the bar for what production-grade means at a bank run by agents.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: You ramp up on the current infrastructure - how deployments work, where the rough edges are, what is automated and what is not. You pick up your first big project as an IC and start shipping. You pair with the Lead DevOps but operate independently from week one.

  • Months 3-4: You ship your first big project - for example, PR environment deployments or multi-region infrastructure. You scope the next project on the roadmap.

  • Months 5-6: You shape the infrastructure roadmap alongside the Lead DevOps. You scope, plan, and drive projects as the lead. You are the person the engineering team trusts to keep the platform fast, reliable, and safe.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walke into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

This role is for you if:

  • You will write backend code, learn new tooling, or do whatever it takes to get the job done - you don't see anything as outside your lane.

  • You care as much about developer experience as you do about uptime.

  • Issues that block developers are your problems, not theirs.

  • You are excited about designing infrastructure for a bank that runs on agents, not on legacy systems.

  • You want to own the whole problem end to end, not a narrow slice of it.

This is not for you if:

  • You think DevOps means maintaining Jenkins and writing Helm charts.

  • You are a sysadmin by heart and do not step outside of infrastructure.

  • You need a well-defined scope handed to you before you can start.

  • You are not comfortable operating under banking-grade regulatory scrutiny.

  • You need a large team around you to be effective.

Hard Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or similar roles.

  • Cloud Fluency: Advanced hands-on experience with AWS (IAM, EC2, EKS, VPC, CloudWatch, etc.).

  • Kubernetes Mastery: Ability to design, debug, and operate production-grade Kubernetes environments.

  • IaC Expertise: Strong experience with Terraform (modules, workspaces, complex architectures).

  • Automation Mindset: Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages for automation and tooling.

  • CI/CD: Experience designing and maintaining GitHub Actions - or comparable CI/CD systems.

  • Observability: Familiarity with metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and incident response best practices.

  • Communication: You make complex infra concepts intuitive for developers and stakeholders.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate - this is an in-person role. We build together.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €75,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Rust/Python) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Your Role

We are seeking a versatile Senior Software Engineer to drive the development and end-to-end lifecycle management of our next-generation software products. In this role, you will hold comprehensive ownership over the software you build—from initial design to production deployment. Your scope will include developing high-performance Rust command-line interfaces (CLIs), robust REST APIs, and web services, while simultaneously architecting the underlying CI/CD pipelines, automated security scanning, compliance frameworks, and distribution models.

Our engineering team operates with high adaptability. While your immediate priority will be anchoring our Rust-based development, you possess strong full-stack capabilities. You are equally comfortable pivoting to contribute to our core Python, FastAPI, and AWS cloud ecosystem to support shifting business objectives and ensure continuous product delivery.

Your future tasks at a glance

  • Multi-Stack Software Engineering: Architect and maintain high-performance, concurrent applications in Rust, alongside feature development and maintenance within our Python and FastAPI microservices.

  • Complete SDLC Ownership: Establish and maintain the entire software development lifecycle infrastructure around your applications, including unit testing, integration testing, license compliance, and automated vulnerability scanning.

  • Release & Distribution Automation: Design and optimize the build, compilation, containerization, and secure distribution processes for internal and public-facing software tools.

  • Cloud & DevOps Integration: Support and evolve our cloud environments, security architectures, and remote build platforms hosted on AWS.

What you bring with you

  • Senior Engineering Background: A university degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent extensive industry experience delivering production-grade software systems.

  • Work cross-functionally – collaborate seamlessly with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing, serving as the voice of the customer internally and advocating for improvements that enhance user experience.

Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. About Us

At VREY, we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings.

Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.

At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.

What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.

VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software, enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:

  • Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,

  • ~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and

  • digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.

We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. In the course of our seed financing, we raised €3.3M from leading impact and energy VCs (including Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, and Kopa Ventures). We're now entering the next growth phase and expanding our team.

We're at the beginning of a structural market shift. Join us and help build the leading EnergyOS.

Your Profile

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building full-stack web applications, ideally with Ruby on Rails. Experience in comparable frameworks (Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, NextJS) will also be considered, if you are truly motivated to learn and work with Rails.

  • You have strong frontend development skills, ideally with solid fundamentals (HTML, CSS and JavaScript), as well as familiarity with the Rails-specific frontend technology (Hotwire, Turbo and Stimulus) and a framework like React or Vue.

Your Responsibilities

You'll be an early member of our growing product development team, working across the entire stack. Currently that's a straight-forward Ruby on Rails app + PostgreSQL + Hotwire on Heroku which we will specialize and optimize as we're scaling.

The core functionality of the VREY platform is processing smart meter measurement data for analyzing and billing solar power usage. For this purpose, we provide landlords and tenants with a portal and automate contract management, invoicing and payment flows. An admin interface and integration with internal tools enable the creation and management of projects by our operations team.

You focus on the users' perspectives, get involved in interface design discussions and actively shape both the product and the team.

1. Full-stack feature development and UI quality

  • You co-design and build features across the full stack, from database to UI

3. Technical design, architecture and engineering excellence

  • You research, evaluate and design technical solutions to new problems together with the team.

  • You contribute to our aspiration to get better and more efficient as engineers and as a team every day.

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You're a super IC in a small, elite engineering team. You work on core banking systems and own projects end to end. You take on big projects, drive them yourself, and deliver.

You work with engineering, product, and clients. You turn complex financial problems into clean code. You're trusted with the big calls from day 1; system design, technical tradeoffs, what we build and what we don't. The team is small on purpose, that means you have a lot of ownership, you move fast, and you make decisions that actually matter.

You're part of the product engineering team building the Programmable Bank - a bank for the new age of money movement, built around Digital Assets and AI. Your team builds the banking core across bare metal central bank infrastructure and blockchain infrastructure. We're building a Swiss clock: your job is precision engineering, translating a complex system into simple, clean code that runs reliably at scale.

Your First Six Months

Understand the codebase and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: You ramp up fast. Understand the codebase, the domain, the product and ship meaningful code in your first weeks. Pick up a major project as an IC and start driving it. You're pairing with the team but operating independently early.

  • Months 3-4: You've shipped your first big project end to end. You know the domain well enough to push back on product decisions when something doesn't make sense. You're starting to influence technical direction - how we model data, how we handle edge cases, where we take shortcuts and where we don't.

  • Months 5-6: You're one of the people the team relies on for the hardest problems. You scope and drive projects autonomously. You have strong opinions on how the core banking systems should evolve and you're acting on them. Junior engineers come to you because your code is clean and your thinking is clear.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • Relentless: You can't leave something broken. You don't stop because it got hard or because no one is watching.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

This role is for you if:

  • Your former teammates would put you in the top 5% of engineers they've worked with - your code is clean, correct, and easy to delete.

  • You merge your PR today, not tomorrow. You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfection.

  • You want to build core banking systems that handle real money, not another CRUD app.

  • You care about simplicity more than cleverness.

  • You'd rather own a problem end to end than wait for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You want to work alongside people who are genuinely great at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You think that a new fancy pattern or architecture principle will solve all your problems.

  • You think "that's not my problem" is an acceptable answer.

  • You can not follow other team member’s decisions.

  • You are closing your macbook at 5pm sharp and don’t care about your work.

  • You are not passionate about what you do.

Hard Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience (backend-focused).

  • 2+ years in early-stage or small startup environments.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Das erwartet dich

aleno ist Liebe. Liebe für Hospitality, für Tech und für das großartige Team, das bei uns beides Tag für Tag verbindet. 

Dieses Team wollen wir jetzt um eine Schlüsselrolle erweitern: einen Marketer auf Senior-Level, der das Marketing bei aleno übernimmt und richtig groß macht. 
Durch eigene Ideen, das richtige Skillset und vor allem eine stark ausgeprägte Hands-On-Mentalität. 


Was wir von der Position erwarten

Bei aleno wirst du zum “Unternehmer/ Unternehmerin im Unternehmen”. Du bist unser Marketing – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Konkret heißt das: 

  • Marketing bei aleno in seiner ganzen Breite: Marke stärken und weiterentwickeln (Brand) und Wachstum treiben (Growth). Beides, nicht nur eins davon. 

  • Du legst das Fundament: Zum Start bist du unser Marketing. Die einzige Person im Team. Auf dem, was du aufbaust, wächst die Abteilung weiter, auch personell. 

  • Strategie mitgestalten und selbst umsetzen: Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung legst du fest, wohin es geht. Danach übernimmst du: definieren, umsetzen, messen, nachschärfen, reporten. 

  • Du entwickelst Strukturen weiter: Du setzt Marketing-Automation und den richtigen Tool-Stack auf, pflegst und optimierst sie. 

  • Du arbeitest “Data & KI first”: Deine Entscheidungen basieren auf Daten, nicht nur auf Bauchgefühl. KI ist für dich kein “nice to have”, sondern tägliches Werkzeug, das du schon gekonnt einsetzt. Für Content, Kampagnenoptimierung, Analysen, usw. 


Woran du gemessen wirst

  • Wachstum: Deine Maßnahmen sorgen für mehr und bessere Leads, die in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit Sales zu echtem Umsatz werden. (Sales Qualified Leads & Revenue) 

  • Markenbekanntheit: aleno wird im DACH-Raum als Marke sichtbarer und stark in der Hospitality-Szene wahrgenommen. 

  • Wirksames Marketing: Alles, was du tust, zahlt messbar auf unsere gemeinsamen Wachstumsziele ein, nicht auf Vanity Metriken.


Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung auf Senior-Level: Du hast mehrere Jahre Marketing-Erfahrung und einen Track Record, den man an Ergebnissen ablesen kann. 

  • Brand und Growth: Du bist breit aufgestellt und stark in beidem, Marke aufbauen und Wachstum treiben. 

  • KI- und Datenkompetenz: Du triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und setzt KI im Alltag gekonnt als Werkzeug ein. Und du weißt, worauf es ankommt, um auch mit KI hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzeugen.

  • Technisches Standing: Du bewegst dich sicher auf Website, Landingpages und in den Werbekonten von Google und Meta. 

  • Du kennst das Umfeld: Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrungen im B2B- und SaaS-Umfeld. Ein besonderes Nice to have: Erfahrung in der Hospitality-Branche. 

  • Absolute Teamplayer-Mentalität: Wir planen, entscheiden und setzen gemeinsam um. Silo-Denken ist bei aleno komplett fehl am Platz. 

  • Du sprichst muttersprachlich Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch


Warum wir?

Bei aleno zählt mehr als nur der Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich wohlfühlst, wachsen kannst und deine Arbeit im Einklang mit deinem Leben steht. Deshalb bieten wir dir:

Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen
Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt - mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten, Reiseoptionen in der DACH-Region und modernen Tools für remote Collaboration.

Inspirierende Arbeitsorte
Nutze unser zentrales Büro in Berlin oder Zürich – oder finde deinen Flow im Homeoffice.

Gemeinsame Erlebnisse
Von lokalen Team-Events bis zu internationalen Company Gatherings – wir legen Wert auf echten Austausch, Inspiration und gemeinsame Erlebnisse.

Attraktive Vorteile
Profitiere von unserem Corporate Benefits Programm, betrieblicher Altersversorgung, exklusiven aleno-Mitarbeiterangeboten und einem monatlichen Sachbezug von 50 €, der dir zusätzlichen Freiraum gibt.

Erholung & Ausgleich
Genieße 29 Urlaubstage plus zusätzliche Sonderurlaubstage (z.B.: Geburtstag, Hochzeit) – weil wir wissen, dass gute Ideen auch Pausen brauchen.

Fair & zukunftsorientiert
Dich erwartet ein fixes Gehalt mit Bonusmodell sowie ein Compensation Package inklusive Equity-Optionen – klar, transparent und mit Blick auf deine Zukunft.


Rahmenbedingungen

Arbeitsort: Berlin
Start: Ab sofort
Vollzeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten


Bewerbungsprozess

Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Unser Bewerbungsprozess besteht aus vier Gesprächsrunden: 

  • einem ersten 30 minütigen Kennenlernen
  • ein 30-minütiges Fachgespräch zur Beurteilung deiner Marketingkenntnisse
  • einer Case Study
  • einem in-Person Treffen mit unserem Berliner Team

Wir bemühen uns, den gesamten Prozess innerhalb von 3 Wochen abzuschließen und melden uns schnellstmöglich bei dir.

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Game Designer to work on Hunt: Showdown in our new state-of-the-art office in Frankfurt, Germany. In this role, you act as a bridge between all departments involved in the project and help bring complex, cutting-edge gameplay and meta features to life. You work closely with design, programming, QA, and other teams to ensure features are implemented smoothly and meet both creative and qualitative goals.

This is a hands-on role. You take ownership of features from concept through implementation and iteration. You are responsible for delivering high-quality gameplay and meta systems and supporting the team with your game design expertise.


What You'll Do
  • Take ownership of gameplay and meta features from early concept through to polished in-game implementation.
  • Design and support implementation of gameplay and meta systems using proprietary tools.
  • Create and maintain asset databases in CRYENGINE to support the team’s work.
  • Collaborate closely with design, programming, and QA to build features that meet both creative and technical goals.
  • Participate in regular playtests and use feedback to continuously improve your work.
  • Iterate on features to achieve a high level of quality, usability, and player experience.
  • Work together with other departments to ensure all required resources are aligned and delivered on time.
  • Observe and feedback on the game’s LIVE sentiment to stay on top of community hot topics, drive balancing decisions, and help prioritize pain points.
  • Share your game design knowledge and support others on the team when needed.
  • Contribute ideas to improve tools, systems, and workflows for everyone.
  • Partner with QA to identify, debug, and resolve issues in gameplay systems.

    • What You Bring
  • 5+ years of experience in Game Design within the game industry or a similar role.
  • Solid understanding of implementing and balancing gameplay and meta systems.
  • Strong Game Design skills in a LIVE/GaaS environment.
  • Passion for FPS-Games and Extraction Genre.
  • Experience with progression systems, economy design, and live service balancing.
  • Ability to communicate ideas clearly, both verbally and in documentation.
  • Motivation to learn, grow, and take on new challenges.
  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt, Germany.

    • Nice To Have (Not Required)
  • Advanced knowledge of Office tools (e.g. Excel macros).
  • Knowledge of visual scripting tools or programming languages.
  • Experience designing AI and working with behavior trees.
  • Experience with character or art pipelines and workflows.
  • Active player of Hunt: Showdown 1896.

    • What you can expect from us

    Career Path 
    Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives. 
     
    Relocation Support 
    We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family. 
    You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
     
    Company Apartment 
    To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
     
    Public Transport Pass 
    Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
     
    Gym Card 
    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
     
    State-of-the-art Office
    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
     
    Hybrid Working
    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
     
    Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
    We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
     
    German Classes 
    Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family. 
      
    Events
    Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
     
    Vacation Days 
    At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.
