About the role

Our Engineering and Product Design teams are building multiple verticals on our platform at high speed, leveraging AI and building agentic functionality into the platform itself. As we scale into the world's largest regulated financial institutions, identity and access management (IAM), authorization, and fine-grained permissions have become foundational to our enterprise readiness.

We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to join the team building Taktile's IAM and permissions platform: the authorization backbone that powers enterprise-grade access control across our product.

Joining us, you'll design and build permission models and access controls end-to-end, from the React/TypeScript access-management and admin UIs down to the Python (FastAPI) authorization services. You'll take on the problems that make enterprise authorization genuinely hard: multi-tenant isolation, fine-grained permission checks in the hot path of millions of decisions a day, audit and access trails, and the constraints of regulated financial services.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and operate core authorization primitives such as roles, policies, and fine-grained permission checks (RBAC/ReBAC), along with the authentication and SSO/OAuth/OIDC flows that sit on top of them.

  • Guarantee strict multi-tenant isolation so every customer's data and decisions stay fully segregated.

  • Keep fine-grained permission checks fast in the hot path of millions of automated decisions per day, where both latency and correctness are non-negotiable.

  • Build audit and access-trail capabilities that give customers and auditors a verifiable record of who accessed what, when, and why.

  • Design for regulated-industry constraints (financial services, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, data residency), where access control is a compliance requirement, not just a feature.

  • Leverage leading edge AI tools (e.g. Claude) on a daily basis to build industry-shaping AI-native capabilities.

Requirement:

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack experience building backend services in Python (FastAPI or equivalent), including REST APIs and databases

  • Strong proficiency with React and TypeScript.

  • Experience building access control systems, with exposure to authentication and authorization concepts (RBAC, SSO, OAuth/OIDC, multi-tenant permissions).

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with a passion for simplicity and precision.

  • Experience integrating into AWS or similar cloud providers.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential as we operate in a remote environment requiring clear and effective communication.

Nice, but not required

  • Deeper backend specialization (async patterns, performance tuning, data modeling).

  • DynamoDB or Postgres, SQLAlchemy.

  • Hands-on experience designing authorization systems at scale: fine-grained / ReBAC models, policy engines (OpenFGA or Zanzibar-style systems, OPA), or multi-tenant RBAC for enterprise SaaS.

  • Prior ops or on-call experience.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up.

About Us
Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions—approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, stopping fraud before it spreads, and financing every business worth funding. Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. jobs.title: Head of Finance Automation/ AI Agentification
jobs.description:
Finance at Rohlik is being rebuilt to run on AI. We already have agents in production that chase overdue payments, process invoices, allocate cash and clear the team's inbox. The pieces work. What we need now is one person to own the whole thing and make it deliver at scale.

 

Role Overview

This is a new role that owns how AI and automation reshape of the finance operating model across the Group. You will take a programme that is already live across procure to pay, order to cash and our shared services centre, and turn it from a set of promising experiments into the way finance actually runs.

You report to the Group CFO. You inherit a small team and a live roadmap, and you own the result. You decide what gets automated first, you build and ship with AI tools when that is the fastest way, and you hold every workstream to a number.

The role is deliberately hands on. You should be close enough to the work to build an agent or connect two systems through an API with AI assistance, even though you are not a software developer. You should also be senior enough to redesign how finance works and bring the rest of the business with you.

 

Why this role is exciting

  • You’ll inherit a live AI programme with real agents, real data and real impact from day one — not a greenfield slide deck.

  • You’ll shape how Finance actually runs across the Group as we move toward the next stage of growth — including the journey toward IPO readiness.

  • You’ll have access to a top-notch AI-first tech stack and the freedom to use it pragmatically.

  • You’ll work directly with the Group CFO, with fast decisions and no corporate red tape.

  • Your good ideas will be implemented almost immediately — not parked in a roadmap waiting for HQ approval.

  • You’ll lead a small team, but this is not a “manager from a distance” role. It’s highly hands-on, high-impact, and built for someone who wants to make things move fast.

 

What we expect from you

  • Own the AI and automation agenda across finance, from strategy through delivery to measured impact.

  • Lead process redesign the right way: map and understand the as-is, then design an agentic-first to-be rather than automating the old steps.

  • Bring the live programme to its targets, with a clear owner, baseline and deadline behind every workstream.

  • Redesign core finance processes around AI and agents, starting with close, reporting and forecasting.

  • Build and ship yourself when it is faster, using AI assisted tools to create agents and connect systems such as NetSuite, Rossum and n8n.

  • Lead and grow the team (three today) and raise AI fluency across finance and the SSC so the business can use what you build.

  • Track what matters and report it straight: automation rate, close time, cash allocation speed, cost and effort taken out.

  • Roll out across our five markets, balancing local reality against one Group standard.

 

What we look for

You have probably spent time in strategy consulting or in a transformation role, and you are now genuinely excited by what AI can do. You are a sharp generalist who can walk into a messy process, find the real problem, and fix it. You are as comfortable in a CFO pre-read as you are in the AI first tool building the thing.

  • A track record of leading transformation or automation programmes that actually delivered. A consulting, operations or generalist operator background all fit.

  • Hands on with AI. You can build agents and integrate APIs with AI assistance. You are not a software engineer and you do not need to be, but the tooling does not scare you.

  • A good grasp of how a finance function runs, or the speed to learn it fast.

  • You set baselines, name owners, hit deadlines, and say so early when something slips.

  • You can lead a small team and still do the work yourself.

  • You prioritise by impact and move fast. Better done than perfect.

  • You bring finance, tech and operations along with you.

  • Fluent in English. other languages will be an advantage.

  • Regular travel to Prague HQ required (min. 4 days per month)

What we offer

  • Unlimited vacation days to support a healthy work-life balance

  • Monthly vouchers: €45 tax-free via become.1

  • €20 monthly internet allowance

  • Knuspr Xtra account and 10% discount in the form of Knuspr credits / cashback

  • Great discounts through Corporate Benefits – fitness, travel, tickets, shopping and much more

  • Real growth: we’re not a traditional corporate.

  • Knuspr vibe: an international team, flat hierarchy, and a first-name culture where mistakes are seen as opportunities to learn

jobs.title: Senior Communications Specialist (Global Communications)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Help shape how one of Europe's most ambitious deep-tech companies is understood by the world.

  • As a member of the Communications team, you will lead the execution of our global communications workstream, translating company priorities into high-impact media engagement, executive positioning and integrated campaigns—ensuring the right stories reach the right audiences at the right time.

  • Use communications to help secure financing, build trust, shape public debate and make one of the world's most ambitious engineering projects visible long before its impact becomes obvious.

  • Own communications around Proxima's defining moments—from engineering breakthroughs to strategic partnerships and political milestones.

  • Pair strategic judgement with exceptional execution, identifying the stories that matter and bringing them to life with creativity, precision and impact.

  • Build trusted relationships with journalists across business, technology, science and political media across our key markets

  • Create high-impact media opportunities around Proxima's biggest moments through proactive pitching, interviews, briefings and lab tours.

Corporate communications and thought leadership

  • Develop interview briefings, opinion pieces and executive messaging that position Proxima's leadership among the leading voices shaping the future of fusion, industrial innovation and European technology.

  • Translate complex technical, commercial and political topics into compelling narratives for investors, policymakers, industry partners, future talent and the public, ensuring every communication reinforces Proxima's strategic positioning.

  • Proactively identify story angles, campaign ideas and emerging communications opportunities that help Proxima lead the conversation around fusion, industrial innovation and Europe's energy future.

Strategic campaigns and external engagements

  • Turn communications priorities into integrated campaigns with clear narratives, audiences, channels, timelines and measurable outcomes

  • Lead public relations for selected international conferences, sponsorships, exhibitions and executive speaking engagements—from opportunity assessment and messaging to content and delivery.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Program Delivery

  • Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Finance, Public Policy, and Business Operations.

  • working closely with colleagues across Communications and Brand & Content to deliver integrated communications programs.

  • Lead external agencies and specialist partners, ensuring consistently high standards across every aspect of delivery.

WHO YOU ARE

Must-haves

  • 8+ years of experience in corporate communications, media relations, public relations or strategic communications, ideally across agencies and high-growth technology companies or startup to scale-up environments.

  • A strong network of or the credibility to quickly build trusted relationships with German and international journalists across business, technology and science media.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist FMTA
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.


Meet the team behind this journey: Foundation Model Task Adaptation

We are the team behind DeepL’s post-training stack for large language models. We focus on developing algorithms and systems that align pre-trained models with tasks and performance goals through techniques like reinforcement learning. As a research-driven team, we stay up to date with current literature to integrate cutting-edge ideas into our core stack. As part of this team, you will shape the future of how our models learn beyond pre-training: enabling new capabilities, better controllability, and safer, more effective user experiences.

 

Your responsibilities

As a Senior Research Scientist, you’ll design, implement, and deploy cutting-edge research in reinforcement learning and post-training at scale, driving innovations that make it into production.

You will:

  • Build and deploy state-of-the-art reinforcement learning pipelines at scale.

  • Post-train large (multi-modal) models to align them with human intent and enable general capabilities such as reasoning, pushing the boundaries of model performance, safety, and efficiency

  • Always keep the entire lifecycle of research and production in mind: from idea conception, theoretical modeling, prototyping, ablation studies, all the way to production deployment

  • Build and foster external collaborations with academic and industrial partners

  • Follow scientific and technical standards for experimentation, reproducibility, and model evaluation

  • Collaborate deeply with Engineering, ML Platform, and HPC teams to deliver robust and reliable model updates to users

Qualities we look for

We’re looking for a scientist with a deep technical background, strong leadership skills, and a proven track record of driving research in reinforcement learning or large-scale model alignment to production.

  • We are seeking researchers with a strong practical background, a creative mindset, and a passion for solving hard problems with real-world impact.

  • You have a solid mathematical background and enjoy solving challenging problems, evidenced by a masters degree, diploma, PhD, or equivalent industry experience in mathematics, physics, computer science, or a related field.

  • Deep practical experience in Python and at least one modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX, experience working with large compute clusters and ML infrastructure is a plus.

  • A track record of leading self-directed research projects that go well beyond academic exercises and deliver tangible results.

  • Expertise in deep reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR) is a plus.

  • Hands-on experience scaling and deploying LLMs or other foundation models in real-world systems is a plus.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office three times a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JB1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.description:
Du kennst den Moment, wenn sich der Ansitz endlich lohnt? Genau dieses Gefühl begleiten wir digital.

Mit MyHunt / Jagdgefährte bauen wir die App, die Jäger:innen, Reviermanager:innen und Naturschützer:innen durch die gesamte Jagd begleitet – von der Planung über die Revierarbeit bis zur Dokumentation von Strecke, Wildbestand und Biodiversität. Hunderttausende Jäger:innen in Europa gehören zu unserer Community, und wir skalieren gerade international.

Damit sich unsere Nutzer:innen bei jedem Anliegen gut aufgehoben fühlen, suchen wir dich: als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support, 20 Stunden pro Woche, vor Ort in unserem Münchner Office.

Und damit das klar ist: Diese Rolle ist mehr als Tickets abarbeiten. Du bist die Stimme unserer Nutzer:innen im Team – was dir im Support auffällt, landet direkt bei Produkt und Entwicklung.

Aufgaben

Als Werkstudent:in im Customer Support bist du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Community:

  • Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer Nutzer:innen per E-Mail, in den App-Stores und in unseren Community-Kanälen – freundlich, verständlich und auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du hilfst bei allem, was in der App hakt: von der Revierkarte über die Wildkamera-Anbindung bis zur Abo-Verwaltung.
  • Du reproduzierst gemeldete Fehler, dokumentierst sie sauber und gibst sie strukturiert an unsere Entwickler:innen weiter.
  • Du pflegst und erweiterst unsere Hilfe-Artikel und FAQs – damit häufige Fragen künftig gar nicht erst zum Ticket werden.
  • Du erkennst Muster: Welche Fragen kommen immer wieder? Wo verstehen Nutzer:innen ein Feature nicht? Dein Feedback fließt direkt in unsere Produktentwicklung ein.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Betreuung unserer Community und bei Nutzerbefragungen.

Qualifikation

Das erwarten wir von Dir

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in (die Fachrichtung ist uns egal) und wohnst in oder um München – wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office, weil Support im Team einfach besser funktioniert.
  • Du hast einen Bezug zur Jagd. Idealerweise hast du selbst den Jagdschein oder machst ihn gerade – denn wer weiß, wie ein Ansitz, eine Drückjagd oder die Streckenmeldung abläuft, versteht unsere Nutzer:innen sofort. Ehrliches, tiefes Interesse an Jagd und Naturschutz zählt aber genauso.
  • Du bist empathisch und geduldig. Auch wenn jemand frustriert schreibt, findest du den freundlichen, souveränen Ton – und die Lösung.
  • Du schreibst gut. Klar, korrekt und sympathisch, auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau) und Englisch (sicher in Wort und Schrift).
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und verlässlich – wenn du eine Anfrage übernimmst, bleibst du dran, bis sie gelöst ist.
  • Du bist technikaffin genug, um dich in eine App einzuarbeiten und ein Problem präzise zu beschreiben. Programmieren musst du nicht können.
  • Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: weitere Sprachen (besonders Französisch, Spanisch, Italienisch), erste Erfahrung im Support oder Service, Erfahrung mit Tools wie Zendesk, Intercom oder Notion.

Benefits

  • Ein Produkt, das du selbst nutzt. Du arbeitest an einer App, die du am Wochenende im Revier dabeihast.
  • Echter Einfluss: Deine Beobachtungen aus dem Support verändern das Produkt – kurze Wege zu Produkt, Design und Entwicklung, flache Hierarchien.
  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung, die zu deinem Stundenplan passt, inklusive Rücksicht auf Prüfungsphasen.
  • Ein Office, in dem man gerne ist: geteilt mit anderen Ventures, Dachterrasse mit BBQ, Kicker- und Billardturniere, Freigetränke und so viel guten Kaffee aus der Siebträger, wie du willst.
